text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With all of Symboli Rudolf's races over, now is as good a time as any to reflect on her achievements.
choice_data_list: I never dreamed you'd claim more than seven crowns!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even I am astonished by the magnitude of what I have accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But it is you who deserves the credit. None of this would have been possible without your unfailing guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. You have made me the swiftest Umamusume there ever was.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I should thank my lucky stars that I chose you that day… Or perhaps I should say that you chose me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, it is thanks to—wait, I see where this is going. At this rate, we will be complimenting one another all day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let us call it a draw and say that we were both responsible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, I do believe we've earned ourselves something of a reward, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Something worthy of commemorating this monumental feat.
choice_data_list: What could live up to that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Struggling for ideas? Well, truth be told, so am I.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… Thinking of gifts for oneself isn't easy, is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But fortunately, we have a great deal of time. If we put our heads together, I'm certain we'll succeed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not least because time spent with you is as much of a reward as any.
